target.name: R Draconis
target.note: ICRS/J2000 search center returned by CDS/SIMBAD; coordinate reference epoch not supplied by this resolver response. Not a propagated target ephemeris.

catalogue.adql:
SELECT TOP 201 source_id, ra, dec, ref_epoch, pmra, pmdec, parallax, phot_g_mean_mag, DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),POINT('ICRS',248.167610832950,66.754979417220)) AS search_distance_deg
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',248.167610832950,66.754979417220,0.135947583125))
ORDER BY search_distance_deg, source_id
